laura-bettencourt.text: (2023) As mayor, cast the lone vote against further talks on Santa Monica's proposal to shift some of its state-required housing to Palmdale: "I am wholeheartedly, 100% against this," citing fears of unhoused transfers, traffic and congestion.

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Palmdale, Santa Monica talk housing (2023-02-17)

laura-bettencourt.text: (2023) On a resolution opposing outside jurisdictions sending unhoused people to Palmdale: "We are going to defend our city, we're going to protect our residents, we're going to protect our quality of life."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: City sharpens resolution on homeless issue (2023-01)

laura-bettencourt.text: Voiced support for keeping Palmdale's rotating-mayor system, noting every mayor elected during her lifetime before it was a white man, but voted with the 4-1 majority to put a directly elected mayor measure on the ballot: "Let them decide."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Palmdale eyes at-large vote to elect mayor (2026)

franzelle-louis-johnson-jr.text: Proposes a just-cause eviction ordinance and capping annual rent increases at CPI + 3% for pre-1995 housing in District 3, which he says is 33% renters.

source.title: VoteZelle: Franzelle Johnson Jr. for Palmdale City Council District 3 (campaign site)

franzelle-louis-johnson-jr.text: Proposes moving $1.5–2 million (10%) of LASD public-safety overtime into a District 3 Youth Opportunity Fund for summer jobs, after-school programs and a civilian mental-health crisis response team.

source.title: VoteZelle: Franzelle Johnson Jr. for Palmdale City Council District 3 (campaign site)

franzelle-louis-johnson-jr.text: "Palmdale Jobs First Ordinance": developers receiving city subsidies or tax breaks must hire Palmdale residents for at least 30% of construction and permanent jobs, plus a 48-hour small-business permit guarantee.

source.title: VoteZelle: Franzelle Johnson Jr. for Palmdale City Council District 3 (campaign site)

franzelle-louis-johnson-jr.text: Criticizes Palmdale's sales tax as among the highest in the nation and wants every sales-tax dollar tracked; questions a ~$1.3 million-a-year communications contract and $2.5 million plus an additional $7.5 million for the Parris Center in Lancaster.

source.title: VoteZelle: Franzelle Johnson Jr. for Palmdale City Council District 3 (campaign site)

franzelle-louis-johnson-jr.text: Proposes an Open Government Accountability Act banning closed-session removal of elected officials without a public hearing and publishing every council vote within 24 hours.

source.title: VoteZelle: Franzelle Johnson Jr. for Palmdale City Council District 3 (campaign site)

anain-robles.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party.

source.title: Los Angeles County Democratic Party: Endorsed Candidates (2026)
